items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Didn’t Miss on Demand or Devices. A Cyberattack Just Broke Its Guidance.
items.summary: Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE:BSX) fell 2.3% in early trading on September 8, 2026, after disclosing that an August 25 cyberattack disrupted manufacturing and shipping. The company stated it is unlikely to meet its previously issued third-quarter and full-year 2026 guidance for net sales and adjusted earnings per share. items.title: Is This BSX Stock Pullback Worth The Patience?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) trades at about $43, roughly 17% below the recent high it set on 19th Aug, 2026. Its own history with sharp drops is encouraging. That history does not cover a cyberattack it says is likely to hit its 2026 results, and the stock is down about 60% over the past twelve months. Start with the history.

items.title: Is Boston Scientific (BSX) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Boston Scientific (BSX) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?
